The '''Black Eleven Fleet''' was a force of [[Duskhan League]] warships based at [[Doornik-1142/Legends|Doornik-1142]] in the early stages of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="TCSWE Doornik 1142">{{CSWECite|I|200|Doornik-1142}}</ref> They were named for the captured Imperial shipyard [[Black Eleven (shipyard)|Black Eleven]].

==History==
The fleet included a captured [[Victory-class Star Destroyer|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]], renamed [[Valorous (Victory-class)|''Devotion of Yevetha'']] and at least three additional ships of Imperial design, known as the ''[[Purity]]'', ''[[Blessings]]'', and ''[[Beauty of Yevetha]]''. ''Purity'' appears to have been the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of the force, under [[Primate (Yevethan rank)|Primate]] [[Vol Noorr]].<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] scout ''[[Astrolabe]]'' entered the Doornik-1142 system in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], the ''Purity'' destroyed the intruder to prevent the fleet from being discovered.<ref name="BTS" /> The ''Devotion'' subsequently served as the command ship at [[Polneye]] during the [[Yevethan Purge]], while the [[corvette]] ''Beauty'' was stationed at [[N'zoth]] and destroyed there by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilot [[Rone Taggar]].

All the ships of Imperial design in the Yevethan fleet were taken over by surviving Black Sword personnel in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] and withdrew to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].

==Behind the scenes==
The novel ''[[Before the Storm]]'' reveals that the Yevetha were concealing at least one [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] at Doornik-1142, and in the sequel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', the character of [[Gial Ackbar|Admiral Ackbar]] infers that the system was the location of a captured [[Type II Orbital Repair Yard]], but the specific association with the [[Black Eleven (shipyard)|Black Eleven]] yard and the presence of a large fleet in the system are stated only in subsequent reference sources such as the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.

Although ''Devotion'' and ''Beauty'' are explicitly identified as ex-Imperial vessels captured from [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the other named ships may be newly built by the Yevetha using the old Imperial designs.

Two ships accompanying ''Devotion of Yevetha'' at Polneye, named [[Liberty (Yevetha)|''Liberty'']] and ''[[Honor]]'' are likely to have been part of the Black Eleven Fleet.

The capture of these ships and their removal to the Deep Core can be inferred from events in the novel ''[[Tyrant's Test]]''.

No reason is given for why the fleet is named after the Black Eleven yard - the name may indicate the presence of ships captured along with the shipyard at [[Zhina]],<ref name="TCSWE Zhina">{{CSWECite|III|371|Zhina}}</ref> new ships subsequently constructed in the captured facility, or simply the use of the shipyard as a base for a more miscellaneous force of vessels. The fleet may in fact have contained all the vessels of Imperial design under Yevethan control.

The ''Encyclopedia'' does not explicitly state that the Black Eleven shipyard was present at Doornik-1142, merely that a fleet taking their name from the yard was based there. The novel ''[[Tyrant's Test]]'' mentions a strong reconnaissance force from the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet]] being dispatched to the system to seek the shipyard inferred to be located there, but there is no reference to any meaningful result, in contrast with the significance given to the discovery of [[Black Nine]] at [[ILC-905 system|ILC-905]], which may hint that the yard was in fact located elsewhere.
